title: Initiative Convergence Scheduler for Error Budget Handovers
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Summary: Implement an Initiative Convergence Scheduler that automates and coordinates cross-cycle handovers for reliability initiatives. The scheduler preserves SLI target continuity, carries forward error budget tranches, and surfaces pending handovers in the Console so PMs and SREs can approve or override before cycle boundaries.

Why: Currently handovers between cycles are manual, risking SLI drift, orphaned error budgets, and gaps in ownership. Automating the common-case reduces operational toil and improves reliability continuity for customer-facing contracts.

Scope: Backend scheduler + API + Console UI view for ‘Pending Handovers’ + audit logging + integrations with SLO ledger and initiative scorecard. Excludes changes to billing or Dedicated capacity autoscale policies (follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Scheduler can assign initiative ownership to the incoming cycle and preserve error budget tranche metadata
Automated handover manifests and notifications trigger 72h before cycle end when no manual hold flag exists
Console shows a Pending Handovers dashboard with ability to Approve / Reject / Reassign
Integration tests validate SLI target continuity and metric labels remain stable across cycle boundary
Audit log entries created for each handover record with prior owner, new owner, timestamp, and error budget delta
tasks: Draft state machine for handover lifecycle and API contract
Design Console flow and wireframes for pending handovers
Implement backend scheduler, migration for initiative history table, and API endpoints
Integrate with SLO ledger to copy/merge error budget tranches and note provenance
Add E2E tests simulating cycle boundary scenarios and failure modes
Create rollout plan: canary to internal orgs > partner customers > all orgs
Update runbooks and on-call playbooks for handover failures
risks: Nested or parent-child initiatives could cause double-counting of error budgets
Initiatives without a clear owner at cycle end could be orphaned
Concurrent release freezes or infra migrations might block handovers leading to missed SLIs
mitigations: Require explicit fallback-owner metadata on initiatives; validate at creation
Provide manual override in Console and auto-suggest reassignments based on last active owner
Schedule handover window outside major infra release windows and introduce retry/backoff logic
